product_evaluation_context.evaluation_purpose: Test whether a source-bound novelty workflow yields distinct, executable and useful research hypotheses across case, simulator and scoring work at matched cost.

question_or_hypothesis: A failure-ledger and closest-prior/rival-prediction method produces more source-relative distinct, executable and useful hypotheses per total author/reviewer cost than ordinary ideation, without suppressing mechanism diversity.
conditions: Same frozen source facts, dated prior work, author/reviewer budget and proposal count across four factorial arms; generic-creativity arm is a separate matched benchmark
Raw author proposals are sealed before blind extraction of common semantic fields; ordinary controls are not instructed to fill treated method fields
Blind independent first-form novelty and feasibility reviews before arm join
Balanced, predeclared execution subset includes lower-rated executable ideas

variables_or_interventions.name: closest-prior and rival-prediction requirement
variables_or_interventions.planned_value: absent versus explicit comparator and divergent observation

environment: Source-pinned case, simulator and scorer research packets; no participant recording or employment decision.
prerequisites: Neutral source-steward verification of frozen source/failure packets and common prior list
Matched arm prompts and raw-output envelope; v2 feasibility allocation prepared but unrun
Independent reviewers and a stable semantic fixture set
stop_rules: Source packs differ in facts or access
Novelty adjudication or execution selection is too unstable to interpret
limitations: No source-steward approval, run, independent review or executed-value result
The 15-cell v2 feasibility allocation supports format/cost preflight only
Measurement Method carrier and typed relations remain to be prepared
claim_ceiling: Candidate experiment design only; no program novelty finding, case release or product authority.
